about: The `# gen-hooks:` block grammar both parsers read: bin/gen-hooks-lib.js here and scripts/dev/gen_hook_settings.py in the server repo (server#2818). Each case is one hook file's text and either the registrations it declares or an error substring. Only the shared subset is here: no `when:` or `command:` (dotfiles-only), no `args:` (each repo renders it into a different command prefix), and only events both EVENT_ORDER lists carry. A registration is compared on event, matcher, timeout, order, async and statusMessage.

cases.name: one register block
cases.text:
#!/bin/bash
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: PreToolUse
#   matcher: Bash
#   timeout: 10
#   order: 30
echo hi

cases.name: an event with no matcher
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: Stop
#   timeout: 5
#   order: 1

cases.name: two register blocks in one file
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: SessionStart
#   matcher: startup
#   timeout: 10
#   order: 20

# gen-hooks: register
#   event: PostToolUse
#   matcher: Edit|Write
#   timeout: 30
#   order: 40

cases.name: async and statusMessage
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: PostToolUse
#   matcher: Edit
#   timeout: 15
#   order: 10
#   async: true
#   statusMessage: Formatting...

cases.name: a library block
cases.text:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# gen-hooks: library
#   reason: sourced by a sibling
"""Docstring."""

cases.name: a block ends at the first line that is not a continuation
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: Stop
#   timeout: 5
# a plain comment
#   order: 9

cases.name: an unknown key
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: Stop
#   bogus: x
cases.error: unknown key 'bogus' in a register block

cases.name: a duplicate key
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: Stop
#   event: Stop

cases.name: a non-integer order
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: Stop
#   timeout: 5
#   order: first
cases.error: order must be a non-negative integer, got 'first'

cases.name: an unknown event
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: PreToolUze
#   timeout: 5
#   order: 1

cases.name: async with a value other than true
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: Stop
#   timeout: 5
#   order: 1
#   async: false

cases.name: a library block with no reason
cases.error: a library block needs a reason: line

cases.name: two library blocks
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: library
#   reason: one
# gen-hooks: library
#   reason: two

cases.name: a library block beside a register block
cases.text:
# gen-hooks: library
#   reason: one
# gen-hooks: register
#   event: Stop
#   timeout: 5
#   order: 1
cases.error: is marked library but also carries a register block
